estimate_label: Experiment Version 2 — Development CV Estimate — RBF SVM nested search
search: 60 preregistered randomized joint candidates, shared across outer folds; 12 unit-weight controls and 48 custom-weight candidates
class_weight_policy: All six class multipliers drawn independently; no balanced inverse-frequency rule
selection: Highest mean inner fixed-six-class Macro F1, exact ties by candidate order; no outer feedback or early stopping
benchmark_definition: Fixed lsqr LDA shrinkage .8 with StandardScaler and existing capped SMOTE
score_policy: SVC native predict for label metrics; OvR decision_function for per-class AP/ROC. LDA native probabilities for ranking. AP is average precision, not trapezoidal area. No SVC probability fitting, calibration or hidden extra CV. Fold scores are primary; ranking scores from different fitted pipelines are not pooled across folds.
preprocessing: Complete scaler/SVC pipeline cloned per inner fold; selected recipe refitted on outer training only. LDA scaling and SMOTE use the same outer training rows only. No feature engineering or threshold tuning.
runtime_policy: Serial execution, one native thread; separate inner search, outer fit, predict/ranking and score timing. The fixed benchmark has zero new search cost; this does not account for its historical development cost.
limitations: Finite joint random search, not a controlled causal ablation of weights. Baseline settings and prior development history already used this data. Nested estimates remain conditional development estimates, not fresh holdout evidence. Fold/repeat dependence precludes interpreting descriptive SD as a confidence interval.

environment.outer_cv: sequential; estimator/search parallelism recorded in parameters
